examples.en: I prepared fruit as a snack for the kids.

examples.ko: 냉장고를 열어 봤는데 간식거리가 하나도 없어요.
examples.en: I opened the fridge, but there are no snacks at all.

examples.ko: 시험공부할 때 먹을 간식거리 좀 사 올게요.
examples.en: I'll go buy some snacks to eat while studying for the exam.

examples.ko: 간식거리는 너무 달지 않은 게 좋아요.
examples.en: Snacks are better when they're not too sweet.

examples.ko: 간식거리에 돈을 너무 많이 쓰는 것 같아요.
examples.en: I think I spend too much money on snacks.

explain: '간식'이 먹는 것이나 그 시간을 두루 말한다면, '간식거리'는 간식으로 먹을 만한 재료나 음식을 말해요. '먹을거리, 볼거리'처럼 '-거리'가 붙어 '그럴 만한 것'을 나타내요. 집에 간식이 있는지 없는지 말할 때 잘 쓰여요.

phrases.en: I bought some snacks at the mart.
phrases.nuance_ko: 간식으로 먹을 것을 장볼 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when shopping for things to eat as snacks.

phrases.en: There's nothing to snack on at home.
phrases.nuance_ko: 먹을 것이 떨어졌을 때 자주 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often said when you've run out of things to eat.

phrases.en: I had a snack in the afternoon.
phrases.nuance_ko: 먹을 것이나 그 시간을 두루 말해요. 간식거리보다 짧은 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Covers the food or the time; shorter than 간식거리.

explain_en: While '간식' broadly means snacks or snack time, '간식거리' refers to the foods you have on hand to snack on. Like '먹을거리' and '볼거리', the '-거리' ending gives the sense of 'something worth doing or having'. It is handy when talking about whether there are snacks at home.

examples.en: It was hot, so I ordered an iced coffee.
Please put lots of ice in my iced coffee.
I like iced coffee better than hot coffee.
Iced coffee tastes watery when the ice melts.
In summer I make iced coffee at home and drink it.

explain: '냉'은 차갑다는 뜻이고 반대는 '따뜻한 커피'예요. 카페에서는 '아이스커피'나 '아이스 아메리카노'처럼 말하는 사람도 많아요.

phrases.en: I often drink iced coffee in the summer.
phrases.nuance_ko: '냉커피'와 같은 뜻으로, 카페에서 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as 냉커피, but more common in cafés.

phrases.en: One iced coffee, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: 카페에서 주문할 때 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A phrase for ordering at a café.

phrases.en: On cold days, warm coffee is nice.
phrases.nuance_ko: '냉커피'의 반대 뜻으로 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The opposite of 냉커피.

explain_en: The '냉' part means cold, and the opposite is '따뜻한 커피' (hot coffee). In cafés many people say '아이스커피' or '아이스 아메리카노' instead.

examples.en: One plate of boiled dumplings, please.
In winter I crave warm boiled dumplings.
I ordered boiled dumplings instead of fried ones.
Boiled dumplings taste good dipped in soy sauce.

examples.ko: 이 집은 물만두 속이 정말 꽉 차 있어요.
examples.en: The filling in this place's boiled dumplings is really packed.

examples.ko: 엄마가 집에서 직접 빚은 물만두를 주셨어요.
examples.en: My mom gave me boiled dumplings she made at home.

explain: 메뉴판에서는 기름에 구운 '군만두', 찐 '찐만두'와 나란히 나올 때가 많아요. 만둣국과 달리 보통 국물에 말지 않고 건져서 간장에 찍어 먹어요.

phrases.en: I dip boiled dumplings in soy sauce and eat them.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물만두를 먹는 방법을 말할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used to describe how to eat boiled dumplings.

phrases.en: One kimchi boiled dumpling dish, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: 속 재료 이름을 앞에 붙여 종류를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put the filling name before it to say the type.

phrases.en: I boiled frozen dumplings and ate them.
phrases.nuance_ko: 집에서 만들 때는 물에 '삶다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use 삶다 (to boil) when you cook them at home.

explain_en: On menus it often appears next to '군만두' (pan-fried) and '찐만두' (steamed). Unlike '만둣국', it is usually not served in soup but lifted out and dipped in soy sauce.

examples.en: Shall we have bossam for dinner tonight?
We eat bossam together with kimchi.
The boiled bossam pork is really tender.

explain: 삼겹살은 구워 먹고 보쌈은 삶아 먹는다는 점이 가장 큰 차이예요. 둘 다 채소에 싸 먹지만, 보쌈은 얇게 썬 고기를 배추나 보쌈김치에 올려 먹는 경우가 많아요. 한국 사람들은 보쌈과 족발을 같이 배달 음식으로 자주 시켜요.

phrases.en: I had a bossam set meal for lunch.
phrases.nuance_ko: 식당에서 보쌈에 밥과 국이 같이 나오는 메뉴를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A restaurant set menu where bossam comes with rice and soup.

phrases.en: I ordered bossam for delivery for dinner.
phrases.nuance_ko: 보쌈은 배달 음식으로 자주 먹어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Bossam is often eaten as delivery food.

phrases.en: We ordered bossam and jokbal together.
phrases.nuance_ko: 두 음식을 한 가게에서 같이 파는 경우가 많아요.
phrases.nuance_en: Many shops sell these two dishes together.

explain_en: The main difference is that 삼겹살 is grilled while 보쌈 is boiled. Both are wrapped in vegetables, but 보쌈 is usually thin slices of pork placed on cabbage or 보쌈김치. Koreans often order 보쌈 and 족발 (pig's feet) as delivery food.

examples.en: On a really hot day, iced coffee is the best.
One iced coffee here, please.
Please don't put syrup in the iced coffee.
I drink iced coffee even in cold winter.
The iced coffee was too weak, so I added a shot.

explain: 카페에서는 '아이스 아메리카노'를 줄여 친구끼리 '아아'라고도 해요. 반대로 뜨거운 커피는 '따뜻한 커피'나 '핫커피'라고 말해요. 주문할 때는 '아이스로 주세요'처럼 줄여 말해도 돼요.

phrases.en: One iced coffee, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: 카페에서 주문할 때 가장 많이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Most commonly used when ordering at a cafe.

phrases.en: I'd like the coffee iced, please.
phrases.nuance_ko: '아이스커피' 대신 '아이스'만 줄여서 주문할 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: You can order with just 'iced' instead of the full 'iced coffee'.

phrases.en: I often drink iced Americanos.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아이스커피 중 카페에서 가장 많이 시키는 종류예요.
phrases.nuance_en: The type of iced coffee most often ordered at cafes.

explain_en: At cafes, friends shorten '아이스 아메리카노' to '아아'. The opposite is '따뜻한 커피' or '핫커피'. When ordering, you can also say just '아이스로 주세요' (iced, please).

examples.en: On cold days, warm cocoa is nice.
I drink cocoa with milk in it.

examples.ko: 자기 전에 아이에게 코코아를 타 줬어요.
examples.en: I made cocoa for my child before bed.

examples.ko: 여기 따뜻한 코코아 한 잔 주세요.
examples.en: One cup of warm cocoa here, please.
This cocoa isn't too sweet.
I still remember the cocoa I drank at the ski resort.

explain: 카페 메뉴에서는 '핫초코'를 더 자주 보고, '코코아'는 마트에서 파는 가루 이름으로 많이 보여요. 가루를 물이나 우유에 풀 때는 '타다'를 써서 '코코아를 타다'라고 해요. '커피를 타다', '차를 타다'도 같은 동사예요.

phrases.en: I ordered a hot chocolate at the cafe.
phrases.nuance_ko: 카페 메뉴에서는 '코코아'보다 '핫초코'를 더 자주 봐요.
phrases.nuance_en: On cafe menus you see 핫초코 more often than 코코아.

phrases.en: I made cocoa with milk.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가루를 물이나 우유에 풀 때는 '타다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use 타다 when you mix powder into water or milk.

phrases.en: I bought cocoa powder at the mart.
phrases.nuance_ko: 마트에서 파는 제품 이름으로 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used as a product name in stores.

explain_en: On cafe menus you see '핫초코' more often, while 코코아 is mostly the name of the powder sold at the store. When you stir the powder into water or milk, the verb is '타다', as in '코코아를 타다'. The same verb goes with '커피를 타다' (make coffee) and '차를 타다' (make tea).

en: to wash; to do the laundry

examples.ko: 주말에 모아 둔 옷을 한꺼번에 세탁해요.
examples.en: On weekends I wash all the clothes I've saved up at once.
This garment shrinks if you wash it in water.
Yesterday I washed the big blanket at home.
Be sure to check the pockets before doing the laundry.

examples.ko: 비가 많이 와서 세탁할 수가 없어요.
examples.en: It's raining a lot, so I can't do laundry.

examples.ko: 세탁해서 말린 수건에서 좋은 냄새가 나요.
examples.en: The towels I washed and dried smell nice.

explain: 집에서 빨래할 때는 '빨래하다'를 더 많이 쓰고, 세탁하다는 조금 격식 있는 말이에요. '세탁소'에 맡기는 드라이클리닝은 '세탁'이라고 해요. '세탁기', '세탁물'처럼 다른 말에 붙여서도 자주 써요.

phrases.en: I do the laundry at home every weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 집에서 옷을 빨 때는 '세탁하다'보다 더 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: More natural than 세탁하다 for washing clothes at home.

phrases.en: I put the clothes in the washing machine and pressed the button.
phrases.nuance_ko: '세탁하다'에서 나온 말로, 옷을 빠는 기계예요.
phrases.nuance_en: Built from 세탁, it means the washing machine.

phrases.en: I left this coat at the dry cleaner's.
phrases.nuance_ko: 집에서 빨기 어려운 옷을 맡길 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for clothes that are hard to wash at home.

explain_en: At home Koreans usually say 빨래하다; 세탁하다 is a little more formal. Dropping clothes at a cleaner (세탁소) is also called 세탁. It combines in words like 세탁기 (washing machine) and 세탁물 (laundry).

dis.h: launder clothes; formal, machine or service
gh: wash hands, face, dishes; general verb
wash someone else, or be washed away

p.n: The replacement is casual and suggests washing by hand.

t90.ax: The towels I washed and dried smell nice.

examples.en: We decided to go to Jeju Island for this weekend trip.
I took a weekend trip to the nearby sea with friends.
I'm packing my bags to get ready for the weekend trip.
If the weather is nice, shall we go to the mountains for a weekend trip?
Last weekend's trip was so enjoyable.
I'll show you the photos I took on the weekend trip.

explain: 주말에 다녀오는 짧은 여행이에요. '주말여행을 가다/다녀오다'처럼 써요. 하루만 다녀오면 '당일치기', 하룻밤 자면 '1박 2일'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: My family and I decided to go on a weekend trip.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞으로 갈 여행을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it for a trip you are about to take.
phrases.en_equiv: to go on a weekend trip

phrases.en: I went on a weekend trip and it was really fun.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이미 갔다 온 여행을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it for a trip you have already returned from.
phrases.en_equiv: to come back from a weekend trip

phrases.en: Let's make our weekend trip plans together.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여행 전에 일정을 정할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when planning before the trip.

explain_en: It's a short trip taken over the weekend. Say '주말여행을 가다' or '다녀오다'. A one-day trip is '당일치기', and one with an overnight stay is '1박 2일'.

examples.en: My younger sibling is doing a puzzle on the living room floor.
This puzzle was so hard that I gave up.

examples.ko: 주말마다 가족과 함께 퍼즐 게임을 해요.
examples.en: Every weekend I play puzzle games with my family.

examples.ko: 친구가 생일 선물로 천 조각 퍼즐을 줬어요.
examples.en: My friend gave me a thousand-piece puzzle as a birthday present.

examples.ko: 저는 어려운 문제를 푸는 퍼즐이 제일 재미있어요.
examples.en: I find puzzles where you solve tough problems the most fun.

examples.ko: 조각 하나가 없어져서 퍼즐이 완성되지 않았어요.
examples.en: One piece went missing, so the puzzle wasn't completed.

explain: 퍼즐은 조각을 맞추는 직소 퍼즐뿐 아니라 낱말 퍼즐 같은 놀이도 말해요. 조각은 '퍼즐을 맞추다', 문제나 수수께끼는 '퍼즐을 풀다'와 잘 어울려요.

phrases.en: I put a puzzle together with my family.
phrases.nuance_ko: 조각을 제자리에 끼우는 퍼즐에 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The usual pairing for jigsaw-type puzzles with pieces to fit.

phrases.en: If you solve this puzzle, I'll give you a gift.
phrases.nuance_ko: 문제나 수수께끼 같은 퍼즐의 답을 찾을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for finding the answer to a riddle-type puzzle.

phrases.en: I do word puzzles when I'm bored.
phrases.nuance_ko: 칸에 글자를 채우는 놀이를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A game where you fill letters into squares.

explain_en: 퍼즐 covers jigsaw puzzles and also word puzzles and similar games. Pieces go with 퍼즐을 맞추다 (fit), while problems and riddles go with 퍼즐을 풀다 (solve).
